name: Gilmore Girls
description: Set in the charming town of Stars Hollow, Connecticut, the series follows the captivating lives of Lorelai and Rory Gilmore, a mother/daughter pair who have a relationship most people only dream of.

videos.title: Unaired Pilot
videos.overview: Unaired Pilot of Gilmore Girls, featuring different actors playing Dean and Sookie, and different sets for exterior Stars Hollow and the inside of Luke's.

videos.title: A Film by Kirk
videos.overview: A spoof on student art films.

videos.title: Pilot
videos.overview: When Rory is accepted to attend a prestigious prep school, Lorelai must swallow her pride and ask her wealthy parents for help paying the tuition.

videos.title: The Lorelais' First Day at Chilton
videos.overview: Rory's first day at Chilton doesn't go smoothly: First, Lorelai's attire offends Emily and the headmaster; then Rory meets some obnoxious classmates.

videos.title: Kill Me Now
videos.overview: When Rory and Richard bond during a day of golf at the club, Lorelai feels jealous of Rory's deepening connection with her grandparents.

videos.title: The Deer Hunters
videos.overview: After Rory receives a bad grade on her English paper, Lorelai helps her cram for a big Shakespeare exam – but catastrophe strikes on test day.

videos.title: Cinnamon's Wake
videos.overview: Lorelai admits she has feelings for someone. Meanwhile, Rory has a budding relationship of her own that is moving forward.

videos.title: Rory's Birthday Parties
videos.overview: Rory clashes with Emily when Emily plans a formal birthday party for her. Meanwhile, Lorelai organizes a casual get-together to celebrate.

videos.title: Kiss and Tell
videos.overview: Rory shares a romantic moment with Dean, but doesn't tell Lorelai. When Lorelai hears about it from Mrs. Kim, she invites Dean over for movie night.

videos.title: Love and War and Snow
videos.overview: Snow strands Rory at her grandparents' home, while Lorelai spends the day with her beau. Meanwhile, Lane misses Rory and comes to visit.

videos.title: Rory's Dance
videos.overview: Rory attends her first dance with Dean but they get home late, causing Emily and Lorelai to fight over Lorelai's mothering skills.

videos.title: Forgiveness and Stuff
videos.overview: Misfortune strikes at the Gilmores' Christmas party. Dean assures Lorelai that nothing improper happened the night he and Rory fell asleep together.

videos.title: Paris is Burning
videos.overview: After Paris causes a scandal by exposing the relationship between a parent and a teacher, she is confronted.

videos.title: Double Date
videos.overview: Lorelai goes on a hellish double date with Sookie, Jackson and Jackson's odd cousin. Meanwhile, Rory double dates with Dean, Lane and Dean's friend.

videos.title: Concert Interruptus
videos.overview: Trouble ensues when Rory takes her friends to a Bangles concert in New York. Lorelai learns something about Luke's romantic past.

videos.title: That Damn Donna Reed
videos.overview: Rory and Dean argue about women's roles after watching "The Donna Reed Show." Emily makes Lorelai face her feelings.

videos.title: Christopher Returns
videos.overview: Rory's father returns, causing tension in Emily and Richard's house – and forcing Lorelai to make a big decision about her family's future.

videos.title: Star-Crossed Lovers and Other Strangers
videos.overview: Rory and Dean celebrate their three-month anniversary, but things don't go as planned. Luke's ex-girlfriend Rachel arrives in town.

videos.title: The Breakup, Part 2
videos.overview: After recent events, Rory keeps busy, refusing to give in to self-pity. Meanwhile, Stars Hollow's residents rally around her, much to her dismay.

videos.title: The Third Lorelai
videos.overview: When Lorelai's grandmother offers a trust fund for Rory's education, Emily fears losing contact with a financially independent Lorelai and Rory.

videos.title: Emily in Wonderland
videos.overview: Emily is horrified when she sees the place where Lorelai and Rory first lived, so she sets out to create a perfect bedroom for Rory in her house.

videos.title: P.S. I Lo...
videos.overview: Still upset over recent events, Rory becomes angry with Lorelai, who didn't tell her that she is dating again.

videos.title: Love, Daisies and Troubadours
videos.overview: Rory finally tells Dean the truth about how she feels about him. Sensing something between Lorelai and Luke, Rachel makes a decision.

videos.title: Sadie, Sadie...
videos.overview: Lorelai makes a big decision, but when Emily hears about it from someone else, she's hurt and angry that Lorelai didn't bother to tell her.

videos.title: Hammers and Veils
videos.overview: Rory's sudden flurry of extracurricular activity strains her relationship with Dean. Emily is cold when Lorelai finally reveals her big news.

videos.title: Red Light on the Wedding Night
videos.overview: During a wild party, Lorelai impulsively calls someone, and their conversation gives her second thoughts about her plans.

videos.title: The Road Trip to Harvard
videos.overview: With her big plans canceled, Lorelai is eager to escape the reactions of everyone in Stars Hollow, so she and Rory take off on a road trip.

videos.title: Nick & Nora/Sid & Nancy
videos.overview: Lorelai tries to dissuade Luke from allowing his relative to live with him. Rory finds herself attracted to another boy.

videos.title: Presenting Lorelai Gilmore
videos.overview: Rory surprises everyone by agreeing to make her debut at a ball, and Lorelai finds herself attracted to a changed man.

videos.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
videos.overview: Advised to become more social at Chilton, Rory winds up in the most popular school clique, while Lorelai helps with a fundraising fashion show.

videos.title: The Ins and Outs of Inns
videos.overview: Lorelai and Sookie have the first fight of their long friendship when Lorelai panics and decides their dream of opening an inn together will fail.

videos.title: Run Away, Little Boy
videos.overview: When Rory and her classmate Tristan are cast as Romeo and Juliet in a school play, a jealous Dean insists on attending every rehearsal.

videos.title: The Bracebridge Dinner
videos.overview: While Rory struggles to keep the budding rivalry between Dean and Jess under control, Lorelai invites most of Stars Hollow to an elaborate feast.

videos.title: Secrets and Loans
videos.overview: Lorelai can't afford to repair her home's extensive termite damage but becomes angry when Rory involves Emily, who again offers Lorelai a loan.

videos.title: Richard in Stars Hollow
videos.overview: Newly retired Richard is driving Emily crazy, so Lorelai agrees to take her father for a day in Stars Hollow, where he annoys both Lorelai and Rory.

videos.title: A-Tisket, A-Tasket
videos.overview: The annual Stars Hollow Picnic Basket Auction causes romantic complications when Jess outbids Dean to win a picnic lunch date with Rory.

videos.title: It Should've Been Lorelai
videos.overview: Christopher brings a visitor to Stars Hollow who wants to get to know Rory. Emily is furious that Lorelai isn't trying to win Christopher back.

videos.title: Lost & Found
videos.overview: Rory panics when she realizes she's lost the bracelet Dean made for her. When Lorelai spots someone in Rory's room, she makes accusations of theft.

videos.title: There's the Rub
videos.overview: Lorelai and Emily's weekend at a spa doesn't go as planned. Meanwhile, Rory's night alone becomes difficult when Paris, Jess and Dean arrive.

videos.title: Dead Uncles & Vegetables
videos.overview: Lorelai and Rory help out at the diner while Luke makes funeral arrangements. Emily goes overboard helping to plan a wedding.

videos.title: Back in the Saddle Again
videos.overview: After helping Rory with her project for Chilton's annual business fair, Richard realizes he's tired of retirement and wants to start a second career.

videos.title: Teach Me Tonight
videos.overview: As a favor to Luke, Rory tutors Jess, but during their first study session, Jess convinces Rory to go on a quick outing with him.

videos.title: Help Wanted
videos.overview: Lorelai helps Richard establish a consulting business. Rory becomes angry that everyone blames Jess for what happened to her.

videos.title: Lorelai's Graduation Day
videos.overview: Lorelai is about to graduate from business school, so Rory secretly invites guests to her graduation ceremony. Rory makes a trip to New York.

videos.title: I Can't Get Started
videos.overview: On the day before the wedding, Lorelai enjoys a romantic evening. Meanwhile, Rory is thrilled when a familiar face returns to Stars Hollow.

videos.title: Those Lazy-Hazy-Crazy Days
videos.overview: Back from a summer internship in Washington, D.C., Rory finds herself torn between Dean and Jess. Meanwhile, Lorelai questions her future.

videos.title: Haunted Leg
videos.overview: Emily's attempts to reunite Christopher with Lorelai and Rory result in an ugly confrontation between Rory and Christopher.

videos.title: Application Anxiety
videos.overview: After a Harvard application arrives, Rory and Lorelai seek advice. Meanwhile, Lane places an ad and becomes enamored with a respondent.

videos.title: One's Got Class and the Other One Dyes
videos.overview: Things get ugly when Lorelai speaks at the high school's career day. To rebel against her conservative mother, Lane does something drastic.

videos.title: Eight O'Clock at the Oasis
videos.overview: After a disastrous date with a man she met at an auction organized by Emily, Lorelai tries to cancel the second date, despite her parents' objections.

videos.title: Take the Deviled Eggs...
videos.overview: When Lorelai winds up attending a social event with Rory, she learns more about Christopher's life than she wanted to know.

videos.title: They Shoot Gilmores, Don't They?
videos.overview: Lorelai forces Rory to be her partner at the Stars Hollow dance marathon, where Rory can't stop arguing with a boy – and another definitely notices.

videos.title: Let the Games Begin
videos.overview: Lorelai, Rory, Richard and Emily visit Richard's alma mater, but Richard causes trouble by secretly making some arrangements in advance.

videos.title: A Deep-Fried Korean Thanksgiving
videos.overview: Lorelai and Rory have four Thanksgivings when they stop for celebrations with Lane, Sookie and Luke on the way to dinner with Richard and Emily.

videos.title: That'll Do, Pig
videos.overview: Lorelai misses the town carnival when a visitor arrives. Rory's beau won't take her to the carnival – until he learns she might go with another boy.

videos.title: I Solemnly Swear...
videos.overview: A classmate convinces Paris that Rory has been plotting against her. Meanwhile, Emily is sued by a former maid, and Lorelai meets an interesting man.

videos.title: Lorelai Out of Water
videos.overview: Lorelai gets an angling lesson from Luke before her fishing date with her new beau. Meanwhile, the political battle between Rory and Paris escalates.

videos.title: Dear Emily and Richard
videos.overview: When Sherry goes into labor and asks Rory to stay with her at the hospital, Lorelai reminisces about the day Rory was born.

videos.title: Swan Song
videos.overview: Lorelai goes away with her boyfriend for a weekend in New York, but she worries about leaving Rory and her boyfriend together.

videos.title: Face-Off
videos.overview: Tired of waiting for her boyfriend to call and make plans for the weekend, Rory goes to a hockey game with Lane, where she sees a familiar face.

videos.title: The Big One
videos.overview: Rory and Paris compete to give a speech at a school celebration. Meanwhile, Lorelai shares a passionate kiss with someone unexpected.

videos.title: A Tale of Poes and Fire
videos.overview: When a meeting of the Edgar Allan Poe Society at her inn is interrupted by a disaster, Lorelai must find rooms for the guests at homes around town.

videos.title: Happy Birthday, Baby
videos.overview: While Lorelai deals with the aftermath at the inn, Rory schemes to give her mom a special birthday party, complete with a gigantic surprise.

videos.title: Keg! Max!
videos.overview: Rory makes plans to attend the prom. Lane's rock band debuts at a big party, where longstanding animosities finally explode.

videos.title: Say Goodnight, Gracie
videos.overview: After the brawl at her band's debut, Lane is in trouble with her mother. Later, Jess receives a visitor at the diner.

videos.title: Here Comes the Son
videos.overview: Jess travels across the country for a visit. Rory helps Emily choose an outfit for Rory's graduation, resulting in a conflict with Lorelai.

videos.title: Those Are Strings, Pinocchio
videos.overview: Rory and Lorelai prepare for Rory's graduation from Chilton. But major developments involving the inn threaten to dampen the festivities.

videos.title: Ballrooms and Biscotti
videos.overview: After returning from a summer of backpacking through Europe, Rory and Lorelai frantically prepare for Rory's move to college.

videos.title: The Lorelais' First Day at Yale
videos.overview: Lorelai helps Rory move into her dorm, where she meets an odd new roommate, and learns that she will also be sharing her room with a familiar face.

videos.title: The Hobbit, the Sofa, and Digger Stiles
videos.overview: Emily redecorates Rory's dorm room without her permission. Lorelai and Sookie cater a kids' birthday party with a "Lord of the Rings" theme.

videos.title: Chicken or Beef?
videos.overview: While visiting Stars Hollow for the weekend, Rory encounters Dean, who awkwardly invites her to an event the next day.

videos.title: The Fundamental Things Apply
videos.overview: Lorelai struggles to hide details of her life from Emily. Rory discovers that college dating isn't easy. Lorelai invites Luke over for movie night.

videos.title: An Affair to Remember
videos.overview: Emily hires Lorelai and Sookie to cater an elaborate launch party for Richard's new company, but insists they prove that they are worthy of her trust.

videos.title: The Festival of Living Art
videos.overview: Rory and Lorelai participate in a Stars Hollow event in which the townspeople dress up and present tableaux imitating famous paintings.

videos.title: Die, Jerk
videos.overview: Rory tries to spice up her articles for the student newspaper. Luke admits to Lorelai that he is revisiting a past relationship.

videos.title: Ted Koppel's Big Night Out
videos.overview: Emily realizes that Richard has been secretly meeting someone for lunch for years. Lorelai accepts an invitation to dinner.

videos.title: The Nanny and the Professor
videos.overview: Lorelai and Sookie renovate their inn. Lorelai enjoys a romantic evening. Rory is irritated by Paris's new relationship.

videos.title: In the Clamor and the Clangor
videos.overview: Lorelai is upset that Luke has gotten an apartment in another town. Rory learns that a guy she likes has been spreading false information about her.

videos.title: A Family Matter
videos.overview: Luke is wary when his sister comes to town. Lorelai hesitates to tell her parents about her new beau. Paris's affair gets serious.

videos.title: Nag Hammadi Is Where They Found the Gnostic Gospels
videos.overview: Rory crosses paths with Jess in Stars Hollow. Luke's sister visits Stars Hollow and introduces her new boyfriend to her brother.

videos.title: The Incredible Sinking Lorelais
videos.overview: Overwhelmed by her classwork, Rory confides in Dean, who's working on the construction crew at the Dragonfly Inn.

videos.title: Scene in a Mall
videos.overview: Rory gets a glimpse of Dean's new life. When Lorelai and Rory spend a day at the mall, they run into Emily on a wild shopping spree.

videos.title: The Reigning Lorelai
videos.overview: Richard is devastated by a sudden loss. Emily receives a shock when she finds an old letter that was written to Richard.

videos.title: Girls in Bikinis, Boys Doin' the Twist
videos.overview: Rory and Paris head south for their first spring break in Florida, where they run into a couple of their old pals from Chilton.

videos.title: Tick, Tick, Tick, Boom!
videos.overview: Jason and Richard are sued. Rory is upset by a decision Dean has made. Dean is told to stop spending time with Rory.

videos.title: Afterboom
videos.overview: Lorelai confronts her father when she learns that he has cut business ties. Luke gives Lorelai an update on his love life.

videos.title: Luke Can See Her Face
videos.overview: A self-help tape helps a depressed Luke realize who his soul mate is. Lorelai is stressed as the Dragonfly Inn's opening day approaches.

videos.title: Last Week Fights, This Week Tights
videos.overview: Jess walks his mother down the aisle at her Renaissance-themed wedding. Luke asks his new love interest on a date. Dean confides in Rory.

videos.title: Raincoats and Recipes
videos.overview: Lorelai invites friends and family to do a test run of the Dragonfly Inn opening. Two suitors pursue Lorelai.

videos.title: Say Goodbye to Daisy Miller
videos.overview: Rory and Lorelai argue about a choice Rory made. Lorelai is happy in her new relationship. Emily and Rory plan to take a European trip.

videos.title: A Messenger, Nothing More
videos.overview: After Rory apologizes to Lorelai, she sends a letter from Europe, which has unintended consequences. Meanwhile, Luke returns home.

videos.title: Written in the Stars
videos.overview: Lorelai is a little offended that no one cares about her new relationship – until it becomes a topic of heated discussion at the town meeting.

videos.title: Tippecanoe and Taylor, Too
videos.overview: Rory and Dean meet alone to discuss where they stand with each other. Lorelai and Sookie manage Jackson's campaign for a town office.

videos.title: We Got Us a Pippi Virgin!
videos.overview: Wanting to smooth over her relationship with Dean, Lorelai suggests a night out with Luke and Rory – but the evening goes awry.

videos.title: Norman Mailer, I'm Pregnant!
videos.overview: Lorelai and Sookie are thrilled when a cultural icon starts frequenting the Dragonfly Inn dining room. Rory discovers an intriguing secret society.

videos.title: You Jump, I Jump, Jack
videos.overview: Logan takes Rory to a mysterious and elaborate event. After discovering that Lorelai has a new beau, Emily and Richard spend time with him.

videos.title: The Party's Over
videos.overview: When Emily and Richard throw a party to introduce Rory to their alumni friends, she has a realization about her boyfriend.

videos.title: Emily Says Hello
videos.overview: Rory and Lorelai plan to convince Richard and Emily to reconcile, but Emily dashes their hopes by making a bold announcement.

videos.title: But Not as Cute as Pushkin
videos.overview: Rory hosts a high school student who's considering the same university, but things don't go as planned. Lorelai and her beau have their first fight.

videos.title: Women Of Questionable Morals
videos.overview: When Christopher visits Rory at college, she rejects his attempt at reconciliation. Lorelai consoles him but doesn't tell her boyfriend where she was.

videos.title: Come Home
videos.overview: Rory offers to help Logan write an article. When Richard sees Emily talking to a man she dated, he has an explosive reaction.

videos.title: Wedding Bell Blues
videos.overview: Lorelai and Rory throw Emily a party. Richard and Emily recommit to their marriage. Rory tells Logan what she wants from him.

videos.title: Say Something
videos.overview: After the disastrous scene at her parents' recent social event, Lorelai begs her boyfriend not to give up on their relationship.

videos.title: Jews and Chinese Food
videos.overview: Lorelai is upset about the recent turn of events. Luke builds sets for the elementary school play in hopes of seeing the costume designer.

videos.title: So... Good Talk
videos.overview: Richard and Emily return from their second honeymoon. Miserable Luke burns food and handles complaining customers by throwing them out of the diner.

videos.title: Pulp Friction
videos.overview: Rory regrets agreeing with her beau to date other people. Lorelai reunites with her boyfriend but remains cold toward Emily.

videos.title: To Live and Let Diorama
videos.overview: Luke helps turn an old house into a museum. Lorelai says too much during an interview about the inn. Rory, Paris and Lane have boyfriend trouble.

videos.title: But I'm a Gilmore
videos.overview: When Rory tells her beau she can't have a casual relationship with him, he gives her an unexpected response. Sookie finds herself confined to her bed.

videos.title: How Many Kropogs to Cape Cod?
videos.overview: Rory begins her internship at one of Logan's father's newspapers. Emily and Richard fawn over Rory's boyfriend, but Lorelai is not as impressed.

videos.title: Blame Booze and Melville
videos.overview: Rory is surprised by the performance review she receives from Logan's father. Luke's plan to buy the Twickham house is threatened by a competing bid.

videos.title: A House Is Not a Home
videos.overview: Lorelai rescues Rory after a night of reckless behavior. Shocked to hear her daughter's plans for the future, she turns to Luke for help.

videos.title: New and Improved Lorelai
videos.overview: Luke responds to Lorelai. Rory faces legal consequences. Angry with Rory, Richard and Emily, Lorelai cuts off ties with them.

videos.title: Fight Face
videos.overview: Rory winds up in a fight while performing community service. Lorelai gets a dog. Luke and Lorelai decide to renovate Lorelai's house.

videos.title: The UnGraduate
videos.overview: Rory takes a job at Emily's Daughters of the American Revolution office and serves as her grandmother's spy. Lorelai won't commit to a date.

videos.title: Always a Godmother, Never a God
videos.overview: Sookie hopes to reconcile the estranged Gilmore girls by asking both Lorelai and Rory to be godparents to her kids, but things don't go as planned.

videos.title: We've Got Magic to Do
videos.overview: After two separate confrontations with the Huntzbergers at a D.A.R. party, Richard and Emily realize Lorelai was right about their treatment of Rory.

videos.title: Welcome to the Doll House
videos.overview: After asking Logan about Rory's future plans, Richard admits it was a mistake to let Rory make rash decisions and discusses the matter with Lorelai.

videos.title: Twenty-One is the Loneliest Number
videos.overview: Both Lorelai and Rory are saddened that their estrangement will keep them from spending Rory's 21st birthday the way they had always planned.

videos.title: Let Me Hear Your Balalaikas Ringing Out
videos.overview: When her former boyfriend visits and reveals an amazing success, Rory begins rethinking the choices she's made with her life.

videos.title: The Prodigal Daughter Returns
videos.overview: After months of estrangement, Lorelai and Rory make their first move toward reconciliation. Luke gets a big surprise but conceals it from Lorelai.

videos.title: He's Slippin’ ‘Em Bread... Dig?
videos.overview: Rory's long-absent father reappears in her and Lorelai's lives, casting uncertainty on what this will mean for Lorelai's current relationship.

videos.title: The Perfect Dress
videos.overview: Wanting to get to know his newly discovered relative, Luke makes a visit. Lorelai sets a date but has a feeling something's not right.

videos.title: Just Like Gwen and Gavin
videos.overview: Lorelai finds out about Luke's secret, but not from Luke. She tries to be supportive, but Luke's reaction hurts her. Logan tries to win over Rory.

videos.title: Friday Night's Alright for Fighting
videos.overview: Luke gets to know April. Rory tries to get the school newspaper published after the staff quits. All four Gilmores vent their frustrations.

videos.title: You've Been Gilmored
videos.overview: Lorelai brings Luke to dinner with her parents. When Rory becomes the new editor of the school paper, her roommate kicks her out of their apartment.

videos.title: A Vineyard Valentine
videos.overview: Rory, Lorelai and their beaus spend Valentine's Day weekend on Martha's Vineyard. During their stay, Rory's boyfriend saves the day.

videos.title: Bridesmaids Revisited
videos.overview: Rory dazzles the crowd at a journalism panel, but the next day, she's devastated to learn how her boyfriend behaved during their breakup.

videos.title: I'm OK, You're OK
videos.overview: Rory forgives her beau. Luke's girlfriend is secretly upset when he spends a few days with April. Rory does some spying on her mother's behalf.

videos.title: The Real Paul Anka
videos.overview: Unhappy because Rory hasn't really forgiven him, Logan takes off with his friends. Rory runs into Luke and April at a bookstore in Philadelphia.

videos.title: I Get A Sidekick Out of You
videos.overview: After she and her mother scramble to accommodate an unexpected visitor, Lane takes a big step in her life. Lorelai gives in to self-pity.

videos.title: Super Cool Party People
videos.overview: When Luke plans a birthday party for April at the diner, Lorelai wants to help and is hurt that Luke thinks it's too soon for her to meet April.

videos.title: Driving Miss Gilmore
videos.overview: Lorelai helps Emily while she's unable to see after minor eye surgery. Rory takes charge of Logan's recovery when he returns home.

videos.title: Partings
videos.overview: Rory throws a graduation party for Logan, but their time together is bittersweet. Lorelai delivers an ultimatum to Luke.

videos.title: The Long Morrow
videos.overview: Lorelai is mortified when she wakes up with an unexpected bedfellow. Rory is puzzled by Logan's going-away present.

videos.title: That's What You Get, Folks, For Makin' Whoopee
videos.overview: Rory is upset when she has to cancel a long-planned trip to Asia, so Lorelai turns her house into an Asian-themed wonderland.

videos.title: Lorelai's First Cotillion
videos.overview: Lorelai realizes her parents aren't as terrible as she thought. Rory's long-distance relationship proves to be a struggle.

videos.title: 'S Wonderful, 'S Marvelous
videos.overview: Lorelai is having trouble fully committing to her current relationship. A relative comes to stay with Luke.

videos.title: The Great Stink
videos.overview: Rory is thrilled when her beau comes to town on business but realizes during a dinner with his colleagues that she has no connection to his new world.

videos.title: Go, Bulldogs!
videos.overview: Christopher treats Rory's college newspaper co-workers to lunch, but the meal ends abruptly when Rory insists they cover a breaking story.

videos.title: French Twist
videos.overview: Christopher and Lorelai take Gigi to visit Sherry. Rory's tenure as editor-in-chief of the university newspaper comes to an end.

videos.title: Introducing Lorelai Planetarium
videos.overview: Rory initially pretends to be thrilled about Lorelai's announcement, but later lets her mother know how upset she is when they're alone.

videos.title: Knit, People, Knit!
videos.overview: Christopher's well-intentioned gesture at Stars Hollow's knit-a-thon brings the event to an early end.

videos.title: Merry Fisticuffs
videos.overview: When Christopher witnesses a sweet moment between a couple, he becomes concerned about his partner's commitment to him.

videos.title: Santa's Secret Stuff
videos.overview: Luke asks Lorelai to write a character reference letter for his court case. Lorelai, Christopher and Rory have a late but extravagant Christmas.

videos.title: To Whom It May Concern
videos.overview: Sookie acts strangely. Luke attends his court case hearing. Lorelai is confronted about the character reference letter she wrote for Luke.

videos.title: I'd Rather Be In Philadelphia
videos.overview: During a family emergency, Lorelai can't reach Christopher. Meanwhile, Logan and Luke drop everything to support Rory, Lorelai, Richard and Emily.

videos.title: Farewell, My Pet
videos.overview: Rory has a crush on the teacher filling in for Richard. Christopher and Lorelai talk about their current relationship with each other.

videos.title: I'm a Kayak, Hear Me Roar
videos.overview: Lorelai helps Emily organize domestic affairs but has trouble revealing the current state of her love life. Rory attends a birthday dinner for Logan.

videos.title: Will You Be My Lorelai Gilmore?
videos.overview: Rory has an interview. Lorelai must settle a fight between Lane and her mother. Logan reveals a failure to Rory.

videos.title: Gilmore Girls Only
videos.overview: Lorelai, Rory and Emily go on a road trip to attend the wedding of an old friend. Someone makes a surprise appearance, asking Rory to forgive him.

videos.title: Hay Bale Maze
videos.overview: Rory shows her boyfriend around Stars Hollow, while Lorelai worries he's too irresponsible. Lorelai and Luke admit they both made mistakes.

videos.title: It's Just Like Riding a Bike
videos.overview: After an awkward encounter, Lorelai and Luke start fighting, which Lorelai takes as a good sign. Rory gets a letter that impacts her future plans.

videos.title: Lorelai? Lorelai?
videos.overview: Rory has a scary dream about what lies ahead for her. A visitor discusses Rory's future with Lorelai. Lorelai pours her heart out on karaoke night.

videos.title: Unto The Breach
videos.overview: Emily and Richard host a graduation party for Rory. Lorelai and Christopher are relieved to find they can still be friends. Logan surprises Rory.

videos.title: Bon Voyage
videos.overview: In this series finale, Rory makes a sudden change in her summer plans, and Luke enlists everyone in Stars Hollow to throw her a farewell party.

awards: Won 1 Primetime Emmy. 23 wins & 85 nominations total
